description:
Bridge ACTION lines in notes and logs into anchored TASK lines, and mutate those anchors.

Invoked with no subcommand it ingests: walks notes and logs, validates every ACTION line, and rewrites each in place as a TASK anchor with a fresh 8-char uuid. Flags for the no-subcommand form only: --dry-run (show what would be ingested, write nothing), --quiet (suppress per-action output).

Subcommands:
  add THREAD TEXT [--due YYYY-MM-DD] [--scheduled YYYY-MM-DD] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID8] — buffer-append a structured ACTION; delegates to `buffer add-action`
  done UUID — flip source TASK to DONE and stamp end with today's date
  set-description UUID TEXT — rewrite the anchor body
  set-assignee UUID PERSON — rewrite the (Assignee) prefix
  set-due UUID DATE — set due date, YYYY-MM-DD
  set-scheduled UUID DATE — set scheduled date, YYYY-MM-DD
  set-priority UUID PRIORITY — set priority H, M or L; written as [#X] in the visible portion
  add-depends UUID DEP_UUID — add a depends entry
  rm-depends UUID DEP_UUID — remove a depends entry
  list [--priority H|M|L] [--thread THREAD] [--assignee PERSON] [--overdue] — list pending tasks
  next — top 5 pending tasks by priority, due, entry
  show UUID — detail view of one anchor

Flags:
  add: --due YYYY-MM-DD; --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD; --priority one of H, M, L; --depends 8-char uuid prefix, repeatable.
  list: --priority one of H, M, L; --thread thread label such as Processes/SGB, matched against the source note's thread; --assignee person name; --overdue restricts to due dates before today.

Examples:
  []
  ["add", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Send quarterly report", "--due", "2026-06-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["list", "--priority", "H", "--overdue"]
  ["set-due", "abcd1234", "2026-06-15"]
  ["done", "abcd1234"]

Notes:
  TEXT for add is either '(Assignee) description' or just 'description'.
  UUID arguments accept a prefix of the 8-char uuid; an ambiguous prefix exits 1.
  Mutating subcommands rewrite the source note or log line in place — source files are the only store.
  `add` writes to the buffer, not to a note: the ACTION only becomes a TASK anchor after `buffer flush` and a no-subcommand `tasks` ingest.
  Exit 1 on: no task matching the uuid prefix, ambiguous prefix, empty description, assignee that does not resolve to a people file, self-dependency.
